notes:
Snapshot from reps:
- Customer: mid-market SaaS (B2B) w/ 300 agents, chat volume ~18k sessions/month.
- Use-case: agent-assist + autonomous snippets to reduce AHT, escalate to human when needed.
- PoC request: 1-week hosted POC with real traffic replay (anonymized), measure p50/p95 first-token and stream continuity.
- Quote from Dir. Product: "Streaming is non-negotiable — customers notice the first token lag. Under 1.5s p95 is table stakes."
- Wants tool-calling: order lookup + cancel/issue-return action; must be auditable and idempotent.
- Ops ask: token-level cost breakdown per route, retention controls for transcripts (90d default, option to extend).
- AE notes: leaning hosted for speed to market; will evaluate dedicated once ARR commitments and SLA language are agreed.
- Risk: EU customer subset wants residency guarantee; might push to Dedicated or Private later.
- Jira refs: INF-1123 (performance flakiness during peak), SEC-987 (SOC2 evidence request).
- POC success criteria: p95 first-token <1.5s on replay, <3% fail-rate on tool-calls, <15% cost uplift vs baseline for same quality.
- Quick wins: enable prefix caching on FAQ flows, recommend batching for backend analytics embeddings.
- Next: POC kickoff week of 2026-03-15, provide streaming perf baseline doc + example SDK snippet for tool-calls.
